summary: Risk-off but mixed: the Dow is down ~400-600 points while one report has the Nasdaq edging up as Nvidia chops around flat-to-down after its beat; FOMC minutes (2 PM ET) and Anthropic's IPO pricing still ahead. Since 08:35: QQQ put trimmed 52->50 on the mixed Nasdaq read; other picks unchanged (quote pages blocked, prices are estimates).

picks.name: Lowe's
picks.reason: Down 2.5-4.7% premarket (~210-214) as the Q3 beat leaned on a 34c tariff refund and EPS guide held, echoing Home Depot's warning; under 209.5 extends, back over 217 fails.

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Rebounding ~5% premarket after a 10% two-day drop as GTA VI reviews land strong ahead of Thursday's midnight launch; over 218 targets the gap, under 210 fails toward Tuesday's 203.9 close.

picks.name: Freeport-McMoRan
picks.reason: Off ~2.5% premarket, an S&P laggard as gold cracks below $3,800 and the stock is down ~21% in a month; under 52.8 extends, reclaiming Tuesday's 55.30 close negates.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Beat-and-raise gap failed: up ~3% premarket, then down ~1.1% after the open as the post-Huang selling resumes; under 152 extends the fade, reclaiming 157.5 negates.

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq choppy (reports conflict: slightly green vs red) as the Nvidia relief faded and the Dow slid, after four straight S&P losses; under 652 extends, back over 661 fails.

picks.name: Marvell Technology
picks.reason: Was up ~4% premarket on the post-Nvidia AI bid, but Nvidia's reversal threatens the gap; holding over 158 still runs, under 152 means the gap is fading.
